name: Staff of Abjuration
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 194, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 492
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 194, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 492
Aura strong abjuration CL 13th
Slot none; Price 82,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
Usually carved from the heartwood of an ancient oak, ash, sequoia, or other large tree, this staff allows use of the following spells:
Dispel magic (1 charge)
Resist energy (1 charge)
Shield (1 charge)
Dismissal (2 charges)
Lesser globe of invulnerability (2 charges)
Repulsion (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, dismissal, dispel magic, lesser globe of invulnerability, repulsion, resist energy, shield; Cost 41,000 gp
